about.title: About
about.bio1: Mid-Level Full-Stack Developer at Loop Brasil, building digital products for Brazil's automotive ecosystem.
about.bio2: Previously delivered high-complexity, large-scale solutions for multinational clients across Latin America and North America, with strong experience in requirements analysis, backend and frontend development, RESTful APIs, microservices, and system documentation.

loop.title: Mid-Level Full-Stack Developer
loop.description: Full-stack development of digital solutions for the automotive sector, with services for retailers, executive and operational fleets, and financial institutions across Brazil.

exata.title: Development Analyst
exata.description: Development of high-impact projects for multinational companies. Customer Experience Data Platform, ESG Engagement Platform, and Warehouse & Logistics Management Portal.

freelance.title: Software Engineer
freelance.description: Development of full-stack solutions using Go, PHP, and modern technologies for various clients.

setebit.title: Frontend Developer
setebit.description: Development of sports betting system using PHP and Vue.js, focused on performance and user experience.

scheduleVisits.title: Schedule Visits
scheduleVisits.description: Dealership vehicle visit scheduling: customers pick a car, browse available days and time slots, and confirm their visit. Layered PHP API with PostgreSQL and a React frontend, deployed on my own infra (Docker, GHCR, and Kubernetes).

smartSale.title: Smart Sale
smartSale.description: Commercial intelligence platform with AI that connects ERP, DMS, and marketplace data for real visibility and faster decisions in distribution, wholesale, and retail. Built at Exata Tech, with Laravel AI (Gemini) on the backend.

customerHub.title: Customer Experience Data Hub
customerHub.description: Robust platform acting as a centralized hub for processing, consolidating, and securely sharing sales and service data with third-party organizations.

esg.title: ESG Engagement Platform
esg.description: ESG engagement platform (Baase) for teams and goals aligned with the UN SDGs. Laravel, Vue, and Inertia in production on Azure. Built at Exata Tech.

warehouse.title: Warehouse & Logistics Portal
warehouse.description: Complete portal for optimizing storage management, transportation, and delivery, coordinating multiple transport providers.

betting.title: Sports Betting Platform
betting.description: High-performance sports betting system with real-time transaction processing.
